$comment: Bespoke voices made with ElevenLabs Voice Design, for auditioning. Previews go to audition/design/; a voice is saved to the account (one of 30 slots) only after the artist keeps it: node scripts/design-voices.mjs --save=<preview>:<voice key>. Synthetic voices, described by character; none imitates a real person.
text: I kept the cups where they were. I know it is silly. I still say we, sometimes, by accident, and then the kitchen goes very quiet.

designs.description: A woman in her late sixties, worn and tender, a soft slightly hoarse voice, speaking quietly and slowly, close to the listener, as if after a long day.
A man in his fifties, tired and gentle, a low quiet voice with a little roughness, speaking slowly and close, as if he has not slept. Restrained, never theatrical.
A young woman whispering very close to the microphone, breathy and intimate, soft and slightly trembling, as if someone is asleep in the next room.
designs.for: the whispered readings: not-going, two-cups, was-it-me, laugh, stay

designs.description: A young adult with a light, small, uncertain voice, soft and hesitant and shy, speaking quietly, as if afraid of taking up space.
designs.for: the lines written in a child's hand: small-minute, angry-with-me, remember-me (an adult voice, not a child)
